_notes: Operator/director-editable knobs for the think tank. Edit this file, then
POST /api/policy/reload (player session) -- or wait for the next import --
for sim.py / serve.py scalar constants to rebind. Every field is validated
against world/config.py:_OPERATOR_SCHEMA; a wrong-typed or out-of-range
value keeps the shipped default for that field (fail-closed per key).
Spend ceilings stay in .env / POST /api/budget -- one source of truth.
Env SIM_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_S / SIM_WATCHDOG_STALE_S override the two
